h1.en: WHAT is the Compressive Strength of Concrete?: Diesel 50 Concrete Pump

directAnswer.en: Compressive strength of concrete is only the order of the sections. The cells under those headings stay the cells already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Diesel 50 Concrete Pump.  The published table prints Diesel Engine (Power) 6105 / 99 kW; Theoretical Output 30 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 150 m / 450 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm; Main Unit Weight 3300 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.

heading.en: HOW to Test the Strength of Concrete?

body.en: Under the source heading “HOW to Test the Strength of Concrete?”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai and name Diesel 50 Concrete Pump. This page does not print a delivery-pipe diameter. Do not borrow a diameter from another model. The specification table does not include a price cell. Leave cylinder bore, piston stroke and service life blank when they are absent above. Image from the source page: https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/35pr.pdf
body.zh: 在来源标题“如何检测混凝土强度？”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。请用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明柴油50型混凝土泵。本页没有印输送管内径。不要从另一台型号借一个管径。参数表没有价格格。上面没有的缸径、活塞行程和寿命留空。 图来自来源页：https://www.nrmca.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/35pr.pdf
